article.title: After giving up on military force, Trump’s new plan to defeat Iran is…more economic sanctions?
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: Trump's "Operation Economic Outcast" to impose secondary sanctions on countries trading with Iran is a tacit admission of U.S. military defeat. But sanctions haven't worked for 47 years, and Iran won't let the U.S. decide when the shooting war ends.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
